mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it indicates monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that drives corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint strength in HOUST and RSAFS (both above 12-month moving averages) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%), the Federal Reserve implements accommodative monetary policy that stimulates equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) reflects labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO is below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Combined strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates sustained economic expansion that supports earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint strength in HOUST and RSAFS (both above 12-month averages) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annually signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% annually.
